title: Fujifilm GFX 100 II 102MP Medium Format
purpose: State-of-the-art commercial studio and editorial medium format with Fujifilm analog film simulation color science (Classic Chrome / Reala Ace).

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Fujifilm GFX 100 II (102MP CMOS II HS Sensor)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 43.8x32.9mm Medium Format high-speed CMOS with 16-bit RAW
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: ~87mm full-frame equivalent classic portrait focal length
sensor_and_optics.lens: Fujinon GF 110mm f/2 R LM WR Reference Portrait Lens
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 80 base sensor sensitivity with Fujifilm Classic Chrome color profile
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 16-bit RAW capture with 16 stops of dynamic range
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Focal plane mechanical shutter, 1/4000s sync capability

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Commercial editorial studio strobe with octabox and subtle hair backlight kicker
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Crisp dimensional separation, subtle tonal gradations, subdued saturation with rich tonal contrast

surface_rendering: Ultra-high resolving power: razor-sharp eyelash and corneal reflections with resolved pore fidelity
Fujifilm color chemistry: muted earthy tones, deep shadows, and luminous skin tones without synthetic magenta tint
Exceptional tactile clarity on clothing weaves, leather grain, and jewelry micro-reflections
depth_and_optics: Creamy, three-dimensional subject isolation characteristic of 110mm f/2 on 44x33mm silicon
Ultra-smooth spherical blur transitions without onion-ring bokeh rings
Flawless chromatic aberration suppression across high-contrast edges

execution_directive: Enforce Fujifilm GFX medium-format resolving power. Combine 102MP sensory micro-detail with Classic Chrome film color science and creamy GF 110mm optical falloff.
